sentences.en: The Internet system is down, so we can't access any websites right now.
sentences.zh: 互联网系统出故障了，我们现在无法访问任何网站。

sentences.en: Our company uses a secure Internet system for all online transactions.
sentences.zh: 我们公司使用一个安全的互联网系统来进行所有的在线交易。

sentences.en: The new version of the software is designed to work better with our Internet system.
sentences.zh: 新版本的软件设计得能更好地与我们的互联网系统配合工作。
